subject: Burnwatch — invoice release cadence and country tax checks
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@evergreen.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Burnwatch — invoice release cadence and country tax checks

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the sync today. Per our conversation, I put together a proposed rhythm for the annual prepay (committed spend) invoicing and the monthly drawdown reporting so both teams have a clear handoff and evidence trail for VAT / tax teams. Attached are a sample invoice and our ACH deposit instructions for your finance team to review.

Proposed cadence (summary):
- Initial prepay invoice: Q4 2027 (issue date: 2027-10-15)
- Quarterly invoice reconciliation + monthly drawdown report (CSV) delivered on the 3rd business day after month-end
- Country VAT evidence pack: delivered with each quarterly reconciliation for EU jurisdictions

Actions we need from Evergreen:
1) Confirm PO number or attach a signed PO (we can put PO on the invoice).
2) Confirm preferred billing entity (Evergreen Ltd / Evergreen EU) for VAT routing.
3) Provide bank remit details or confirm DocuSign for SOW if you want to unlock the first invoice.

Attachments included: sample_invoice_Q4_2027.pdf (stub), ACH_instructions.txt (stub).

Cc'ing Markus and Rishi to keep finance ops and account ops aligned. Naomi — can you advise on the EU VAT evidence checklist if Maria confirms EU entity?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_Q4_2027.pdf (PDF, 78KB); ACH_instructions.txt (text, 2KB)

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@evergreen.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@evergreen.io
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Burnwatch — invoice release cadence and country tax checks

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — this looks clear and reasonable. A couple of items from our side:

- PO attached (PO_98765.pdf). Please put PO_98765 on the invoice.
- For VAT: Evergreen EU will be the billed entity for all EU seats. We will need the quarterly VAT evidence pack for the UK, DE, and IE.
- Can you move the initial invoice issue date to 2027-10-20? Our procurement team has a scheduled payment run the following week and that helps us align cashflow.

We also need a remit confirmation — I will circulate to our AP team and get you a bank confirmation or a DocuSign link for the SOW by EOD Monday.

Best,
Maria
Finance Manager
Evergreen Data

Attachment: PO_98765.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@evergreen.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 12:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Burnwatch — invoice release cadence and country tax checks

Hi Maria — perfect, thanks for the PO and the VAT routing confirmation.

We will:
- Update the initial invoice issue date to 2027-10-20 and include PO_98765 on the header.
- Prepare the EU VAT evidence pack (UK/DE/IE) to accompany the Q4 reconciliation — Naomi will lead that.
- Hold on sending the wire until we receive the bank confirmation or DocuSign link from your AP team.

Next steps (internal): Naomi, can you confirm the expected list of VAT artifacts (e.g., invoices, country-level user counts, representative IP/contract evidence) and whether we should deliver them as a single zip per quarter?

Maria — expect the initial invoice (with PO) on 2027-10-20. If anything changes on your side with AP timing, let us know and we can slide the issuance window by up to 3 business days.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Subject: Internal: Evergreen Burnwatch — ops checklist

Team — quick internal note after Maria's reply:

Summary: Evergreen confirmed PO_98765, wants EU billed to Evergreen EU, and will provide bank remit or DocuSign by Monday. They asked to shift the invoice issue date to 2027-10-20.

Internal asks:
- Markus: please schedule the invoice issuance for 2027-10-20 and include PO_98765 and our standard ledger tag for HB-3482. Attach sample_invoice_Q4_2027.pdf as the outbound invoice.
- Rishi: once the invoice is issued, can you prepare the monthly drawdown CSV template for Evergreen (columns: date, product, token_count, unit_price, subtotal, remaining_credit)? We'll auto-populate in our billing pipeline.
- Naomi: confirm VAT evidence items and if a zip-per-quarter delivery is fine. If you need user-region mapping from engineering, tell me which fields.

Goal: issue invoice 10/20, then first monthly drawdown report covering October usage on 11/03.

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
